_comment: Bitwarden CLI vault status from `bw status` only: no session, no unlock, no sync, no item data. A fixed shell wrapper finds bw (Homebrew, npm under nvm/volta and similar; npm's bw is a node script, so its own bin folder goes first on PATH), and sed drops userEmail and userId before the output reaches BarShelf. BarShelf passes no BW_SESSION, so a logged-in vault reads as locked even while a terminal has it unlocked. A missing reading is null for the stale-sync alert.

command: b=; for c in "$(command -v bw 2>/dev/null)" /opt/homebrew/bin/bw /usr/local/bin/bw "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin/bw "$HOME/.volta/bin/bw" "$HOME/.npm-global/bin/bw" "$HOME/.local/bin/bw" "$HOME/Library/pnpm/bw" "$HOME/.bun/bin/bw"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -x "$c" ]; then b=$c; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$b" ]; then printf '{"installed":false}'; exit 0; fi; out=$(PATH="$(/usr/bin/dirname "$b"):$PATH" BW_NOINTERACTION=true "$b" status 2>/dev/null) || { printf '{"installed":true,"ok":false}'; exit 0; }; case "$out" in "{"*) ;; *) printf '{"installed":true,"ok":false}'; exit 0;; esac; o='{"installed":true,"ok":true}'; for k in status lastSync serverUrl; do v=$(printf '%s' "$out" | /usr/bin/plutil -extract "$k" raw -o - - 2>/dev/null) && o=$(printf '%s' "$o" | /usr/bin/plutil -insert "$k" -string "$v" -o - -); done; printf '%s' "$o"

stateWord.from: if(transforms.ko, switch(transforms.state, 'locked', '잠김', 'unlocked', '잠금 해제됨', 'unauthenticated', '로그아웃됨', 'missing', 'bw 없음', '읽을 수 없음'), switch(transforms.state, 'locked', 'Locked', 'unlocked', 'Unlocked', 'unauthenticated', 'Logged out', 'missing', 'bw not found', 'Unreadable'))

staleReading.from: if(and(transforms.ok, ne(transforms.state, 'unauthenticated'), ne(transforms.syncMs, null), coalesce(settings.alertOnStale, true)), transforms.stale, null)

alertTitle.from: if(transforms.ko, concat('Bitwarden을 ', string(round(coalesce(transforms.ageDays, 0))), '일 동안 동기화하지 않았습니다'), concat('Bitwarden hasn’t synced in ', string(round(coalesce(transforms.ageDays, 0))), ' days'))

alertBody.from: if(transforms.ko, '터미널에서 bw sync를 실행하거나 Bitwarden 앱을 여세요.', 'Run bw sync in Terminal or open a Bitwarden app.')

missing.title: Bitwarden CLI not found
missing.subtitle: Install it with Homebrew (bitwarden-cli) or npm (@bitwarden/cli).

error.text: bw status did not answer. Check the Bitwarden CLI in Terminal.

unauthenticated.text: Not logged in. Run bw login in Terminal.

stale.text: Not synced for more than ${string(coalesce(settings.staleDays, 7))} days.

children.text: Shows status only. BarShelf never unlocks the vault or reads items.
